title: Two shooters linked to Lawrence Bishnoi gang killed in Haryana encounter
summary: Two individuals identified as shooters for the Lawrence Bishnoi gang were killed in a police encounter in Bahadurgarh, Haryana. The incident occurred during an operation by the police. Details regarding the specific circumstances of the encounter and the identities of the deceased were provided by the police.
summary_points: Two shooters associated with the Lawrence Bishnoi gang were killed.
The incident took place in Bahadurgarh, Haryana.
The deceased were identified as shooters.
The encounter was reported by the police.
title_hi: हरियाणा में मुठभेड़ में लॉरेंस बिश्नोई गिरोह के दो शूटर मारे गए
summary_hi: हरियाणा के बहादुरगढ़ में पुलिस मुठभेड़ में लॉरेंस बिश्नोई गिरोह से जुड़े दो व्यक्तियों को मार गिराया गया। पुलिस द्वारा की गई कार्रवाई के दौरान यह घटना हुई। पुलिस ने मुठभेड़ की परिस्थितियों और मारे गए लोगों की पहचान के बारे में जानकारी दी।
summary_points_hi: लॉरेंस बिश्नोई गिरोह के दो शूटर मारे गए।
यह घटना हरियाणा के बहादुरगढ़ में हुई।
मारे गए लोग शूटर के तौर पर पहचाने गए।
पुलिस ने मुठभेड़ की सूचना दी।

framing.left: Left-leaning outlets report the incident factually, focusing on the killing of two shooters linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang in a police encounter.
framing.center: Centrist coverage neutrally reports the killing of two Lawrence Bishnoi gang shooters in a police encounter in Haryana, often including the location and police confirmation.
